citation: Hireko Golf, The Hireko Golf Dynamic Shaft Fitting Index (webinar slide deck, presented 2009-05-01), slides 6 and 7, hosted on SlideShare.

convention.clamp: butt end of the assembled club, head plucked and set in oscillation
convention.club_length: not stated; slides say only 'at the same given length'
convention.swingweight: L flex measured at C-6; A through X flex at D-1

slope_assumption: No length conversion is possible because the source states no length; the repo value is compared unconverted. A forum rule of about 10 cpm per flex step is not used as a tolerance.
